text.en: This Order may be cited as the Fisheries (Amendment) Order, 2020. of section 31 of S 25/2009

31 of the Fisheries Order, 2009 is amended - {a) in subsection (1) -

(i) in paragraph (b) -

(A) by deleting "carries or has in his possession or under his the first line and by substituting "is found in possession of" therefor;

(B) by deleting "or" from the last line;

(ii) by inserting the following new paragraph immediately after {b) - "(ba) is found in possession of fish which has been captured with the aid of any explosive or poisonous substance and who does not give a satisfactory account as to how he came to be in possession

(iii) in paragraph (c), by deleting "or receives, any" from the first line; {b) in subsection (2), by deleting "or under the control" from the third line. Made this lOth. day of Sya'aban, 1441 Hijriah corresponding to the 4th. day of April, 2020 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, DARUSSALAM. = oleh Print Plus Sdn Bhd., Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
